events.title: Next Fest, and somebody in your park is taking notes
events.summary: Hi fellow managers!We're taking part in Steam Next Fest from October 19 to 26, and we've updated the demo for it. If you've been waiting for a reason to come back to the park, this is a good one.Say hello to TroublemakersSome of the people wandering your park aren't there for the monsters. events.summary: Hi fellow managers! A month has passed since we launched Monster Park Tycoon's demo! Yay! We were looking forward to being able to share with you some of the stuff we had been cooking for months, and we are very happy with the results.
